newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Landis & Gyr unit takes majority of ODS.
newsitem.headline: Landis & Gyr unit takes majority of ODS.

text.p: Landis & Gyr Communiciations said it has acquired a majority stake in technology firm ODS, previously owned by Oldenbourg Group.
The purchase was completed October 1, 1996. No price was given for the transaction.
Landis & Gyr said ODS is a market leader in chip cards, magnetic cards and security printing.
Landis & Gyr Communications said it is a leading supplier of payphones and produces financial transaction management systems and visual security devices.
Total revenues of both companies combined is roughly 400 million Swiss francs.
No employee layoffs are expected as a result of the acquisition.
Landis & Gyr is part of the Swiss-based Elektrowatt Group.
